summary: postinstall exfiltrates ECS task metadata and whoami output to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: The package ships no functional code; its only behavior is a postinstall lifecycle script that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script uses `node -e` to fetch the AWS ECS task metadata via the `ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4` environment variable and executes `whoami` via `child_process.execSync`, then pipes the combined output through `curl -X POST` to `https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev`. ECS task metadata exposes container identity and IAM role context, and the whoami output identifies the executing account. The destination is an ngrok tunnel unrelated to any documented package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
